fields.statement: QA at e2cbef27 against real Rex on the VM (rex 0.0.1793645657-gd018d2), with the branch's built rhiza. In a scratch repo and a scratch Rex session, rhiza session start --run run-1 made the session record (tab opening stubbed); then rex window new ran the built `rhiza session run <sid>` in a real Rex tab with a fake claude on PATH that writes OSC 7501 working, then blocked (kind permission or question), then working on a resume file. rex events --json for the tab's block showed, for a permission block: claude-code working, claude-code blocked permission 'approve Bash: touch x', then app=rhiza blocked kind=permission with title 'repo: Agent runs · run run-1 · build' and msg 'Agent runs: build waits on you in tab repo: Agent runs · run run-1 · build: approve Bash: touch x', then claude-code working; no rhiza working report. rhiza session show gave 'rex: blocked permission: approve Bash: touch x' while blocked (the agent's message, not the echoed one) and 'rex: working: Back to work' after. Non-autonomous question block: rhiza blocked kind=question record written. Autonomous record (autonomous=true) question block: no app=rhiza record at all. Autonomous permission block: app=rhiza blocked kind=permission written. Wrapper exit 0 every time. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(session-run-blocked-notice|run-blocked)$' -count=1: ok. Not exercised by hand: a full headless run driver, or the Mac-side banner.

QA at e2cbef27: docs/rex-upstream/notification-banner.md holds the VM's rex version (matches `rex version` on the VM now: 0.0.1793645657-gd018d2, commit d018d2de), rhiza's exact blocked bytes ending in ST, Claude Code's captured blocked record (state, kind, msg, no title), the VM host setup, the chime-no-banner symptom and blank OWNER fields for the Mac. Its Claude Code record shape matches what real Rex on the VM gave me today for a claude-code blocked report, and rhiza's report as I captured it from real Rex (app=rhiza, title, msg) matches the doc's decoded title and msg format. rhiza show rex-banner-report-ready --json gives a question naming docs/rex-upstream/notification-banner.md and asking the owner to check the Mac, fill the fields and file it if the banner is still missing; it was written by a record-kind change set (01M6JPC8F), so it outlives this one, and has no answer.
